title: emdash-cms/emdash
claim: emdash-cms/emdash — EmDash is a full-stack TypeScript CMS based on Astro; the spiritual successor to WordPress
why_good: EmDash leverages the growing demand for TypeScript-based solutions, appealing to developers seeking modern, scalable content management systems.
value: Businesses pay for premium features, hosting, and support, creating a subscription model that generates recurring revenue.
risk: The project may struggle to differentiate itself in a crowded market where established players like WordPress and newer entrants dominate.
